title: Autumn in Barcelona
style: British dream pop, adult contemporary, measured mid-tempo sway with soft trip-hop pulse, intimate female lead vocal with clear conversational phrasing, flamenco nylon-string guitar solo in instrumental bridges, gang-choir echoes answering the lead in each chorus, verses kept spare with rounded bass and hazy electric guitar, choruses widening into layered harmonies, polished warm mix with gentle tape softness and spacious vocal ambience
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Autumn, twenty-two, Barcelona
Dinners after work, your hand near mine
Abdel spoke of plans and open doors
I named my terms; you said they sounded fine

[Pre-Chorus]
You said the old shape never fit you
I thought we could learn a different way

[Chorus]
I know the life that fits me
I know the ground beneath my feet
Friends, desire, work worth doing
No missing piece I need to seek
I know the life that fits me
(We know, we know)
And I can wish you well, then leave

[Verse 2]
You said you were all right with Thomas
Then asked me to explain it once again
Each answer made the room grow narrower
Till neither of us could pretend

[Pre-Chorus]
By twenty-four, we said it plainly
You weren’t ready; I was done

[Chorus]
I know the life that fits me
I know the ground beneath my feet
Friends, desire, work worth doing
No missing piece I need to seek
I know the life that fits me
(We know, we know)
And I can wish you well, then leave

[Instrumental Bridge: flamenco guitar solo]

[Verse 3]
Recife sings across the distance
Barcelona when the leaves turn brown
London waits for spring to find me
São Luís calls me home for Christmas now

[Bridge]
I have no map to follow onward
No promise I am meant to keep
I built a life that holds its own weight
And sleep comes easy in its peace

[Instrumental Bridge: flamenco guitar solo]

[Final Chorus]
I know the life that fits me
I know the ground beneath my feet
Friends, desire, work worth doing
And room enough for all of me
I know the life that fits me
(We know, we know)
I wished you well, and meant it when I said

[Outro]
Autumn in Barcelona
A good life, and it’s mine
